title: Bookstore expands concepts and formats
brief:
Client: Paper Otter Books; contact robin@example.com.
Present two logo concepts in full colour for the new reading club.
Refine one chosen logo and supply full-colour SVG and PNG files.
One revision round applies to the chosen concept.
Concept presentation is due 22 October; final files are due 28 October.
Out of scope: extra concepts, monochrome adaptations and printed stationery.
message: Could you present three logo concepts rather than two? Please also supply a black-and-white version of the chosen logo. The full-colour files are still useful.
